Name: Item Bag - Cloths and Colors
Author: Renazuki
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
An Item bag for the Cloths and Colors - Sewing Skills Expansion by Zombifier. It helps me keep the extra things in a place I can find them without a bunch of chests stashed in sheds and on the farm property.  The Item bag will store the fibers, dyes, yarns and cloths made by the mod. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod
Unzip it in your mods/itembags/assets/moddedbags 
run zee game and have fun[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It is an item bag - hopefully less clutter for you[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Item bags mod is a required[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Cloths and Colors - Sewing Skills Expansion is required[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to Zombifier.  I like the Cloths and Colors mod that it inspired me to make an item bag.  This is my first one.[/color][/size]
